title: /grade step 4 git commands survive ignore rules and pattern characters
item: Step 4's git status, add and commit take verdict paths as pathspecs and skip ignored files silently
motivation: Found by the task 36 reviewers: a verdict matched by .gitignore is left out without warning, and a label with *, ?, [ or a leading : is read as a pattern. Neither happens today.
done_means: An ignored verdict file makes step 4 stop with a message, and paths are taken literally (for example --literal-pathspecs); a test covers both.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-15 from the task 36 reviews. Priority left for the owner.
